description:
Creep around your neighbor’s house performing ever more elaborate tricks upon the unsuspecting resident. 

As the star of a fantastic new TV show, cameras will track your every move as you set your fiendish traps. Your objectives are to create increasing disarray, increase ratings, and maybe even win prestigious awards. But beware of watchful neighbors and alert guard dogs; if they catch you, then the show will be taken off the air.

Features:
● PLAY WITHOUT ADS!
● 14 hugely varied episodes of anarchy
● Use stealth, skill, and style to perform the perfect ambush
● Easy-to-use interface and controls
● Superb cartoon-style graphics
● Excellent soundtrack
● Full tablet support

Supported languages: EN, FR, DE, HU, IT, PO, RU, ZH-CN, ES

Thank you for playing ‘Neighbours from Hell: Season 1’!
